name: The Giles Family
message: R.J. and Todd, you are forever in our hearts. Every day we carry your memory, your laughter, your spirit. Until we meet again. 💜

name: A Friend
message: I remember the way you both lit up every room you walked into. That energy was contagious. You made everyone feel like they mattered.

name: Anonymous
message: Gone from our sight, but never from our hearts.

name: Aundrae
message: My brothers, my heroes, my everything. This whole brand exists because of you. You gave me purpose when I had none. I promise to carry your legacy forward every single day. No Limits. Beyond Limitations. Into My Wildest Imagination. For you. Always.
